# nicholaswilde/scoop-bucket

> Scoop bucket providing CLI tools, utilities, and applications for Windows.

This repository is a Scoop bucket maintained by Nicholas Wilde. It hosts manifests for tools and utilities with precompiled binary distribution for Windows (64bit x86_64, 32bit i386, and ARM64).

## Installation and Usage

- [Bucket Repository](https://github.com/nicholaswilde/scoop-bucket): Run `scoop bucket add nicholaswilde https://github.com/nicholaswilde/scoop-bucket.git` to add this bucket.
- [Install Manifest](https://github.com/nicholaswilde/scoop-bucket#usage): Run `scoop install nicholaswilde/<appname>` after adding bucket.

## Available Manifests

- [cook-docs](https://nicholaswilde.io/cook-docs): A tool for automatically generating markdown documentation for cooklang recipes.

## Development & Maintenance

- [Taskfile Tasks](https://github.com/nicholaswilde/scoop-bucket/blob/main/Taskfile.yml): Automation commands for manifest auditing (`task audit`) and testing (`task test`).
- [Repository Guidelines](https://github.com/nicholaswilde/scoop-bucket/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Scoop manifest specifications, architecture mappings, and SHA256 checksum requirements.
